Executive Directors Profiles
2015
Highlights
BRUNO PESCHEUX, 60 BSc
Bruno, a graduate engineer from Ecole Centrale de Paris, began his career in Lafarge in
July 1990 as a Plant Production Manager in France. He held various positions in France
until August 2001 when he was promoted to Managing Director, Lafarge Asia Technical
Center, Cement Division. In 2009, Bruno was appointed Chief Executive Officer, Lafarge
Cement, Syria a position he held until he was appointed Managing Director of the Bamburi
Cement Group in July 2014.

He is a member of the Nomination and Corporate Governance Committee.

ERIC KIRONDE, 49 BSc, FCCA, CPA(U), CPA(K), ACMT
Prior to joining the Group, Eric worked at Nile Breweries Limited (Uganda) as an Internal
Audit Manager and PricewaterhouseCoopers, where his last position was Audit Manager.
Eric joined the Group in August 2001 as Finance Manager, Hima Cement Limited and has
Sustainability since held various Finance positions within the Bamburi Group and Lafarge, including a
twenty months’ secondment to Ashaka Cement Company in Nigeria. He was Director of
Internal Control for Lafarge Sub Sahara Africa, based in Nairobi before being appointed
Finance Director in November 2011.

DANIEL PETTERSSON, 41 MSc, MBA
Daniel joined Lafarge in 2006 as Strategy and Development Manager, Head Office.
Thereafter, he moved to the Democratic Republic of Congo as Business Development
